mo_ta_cong_viec:
ABOUT THE JOB 
We're seeking Principal, DevOps Engineer who have had a proven track record of running critical shared application platforms in a production cloud environment who will take a team-first approach and can act as a multiplier, making other engineers better at their craft. 
At NAB, we believe success comes from our people. We're committed to supporting your talent and skills through your career, as you help us build a culture that affects change for our customers and for the community too.
YOUR JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
Define and implement tools and processes to standardize and automate software development, testing, deployment, and support.
Ensure consistent CI/CD practices across projects and teams.
Design and deliver secure, resilient, scalable enterprise platforms and cloud solutions.
Provide technical direction and present/defend architecture decisions to senior architects or architecture governance forums.
Automate infrastructure deployment and rollback using Infrastructure as Code.
Lead production incident investigations and drive root-cause remediation.
Proactively manage production risks and improve operational resilience.
Lead cross-team technical initiatives and influence outcomes without direct authority.
Coach engineers and drive continuous improvement in engineering practices.
yeu_cau:
YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
7+ years’ experience in DevOps, Cloud, or Platform Engineering across the software lifecycle.
Strong AWS and/or Azure experience, including Kubernetes (AKS/EKS).
Strong CI/CD and automation experience with GitHub, Jenkins, Artifactory, Docker, and Compliance as Code.
Strong understanding of microservices, APIs, distributed systems, and cloud architecture.
Hands-on experience with AWS services such as EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, SNS, and CloudWatch.
Strong Infrastructure as Code skills with Terraform, Ansible, Packer, and/or Python.
Enterprise platform/solution design experience, with strong knowledge of reliability, security, scalability, and operational resilience.
Experience presenting/defending designs to senior architects, Principal Engineers, or Architecture Review Boards.
Proven technical leadership and cross-team influence without direct authority.
Strong production support, incident management, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
